prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: cat pyproject.toml; find src -name '*.py' | xargs wc -l; mypy 2>&1 | tail -40
cat src/trailhead/elevation.py src/trailhead/pace.py src/trailhead/report.py src/trailhead/track.py; ls tests
cat README.md; grep -rn -i "none\|missing\|,$\|lost\|gap" tests README.md | head -50; cat tests/conftest.py; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -20

D=$(mktemp -d); printf 'lat,lon,ele
42.0,23.0,
42.001,23.0,100
42.002,23.0,
42.003,23.0,130
' > "$D/t.csv"; PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary "$D/t.csv"; PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead plan "$D/t.csv"; printf 'lat,lon,ele
42,23,
42.1,23,
' > "$D/n.csv"; PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary "$D/n.csv"; echo rc=$?

PYTHONPATH=src python -c "
from trailhead.track import parse_track
from trailhead.report import summarise, format_summary
t = parse_track('lat,lon,ele
42.0,23.0,
42.001,23.0,100
42.002,23.0,
42.003,23.0,130
')
print(t.elevations()); print(format_summary(summarise(t)))
try: parse_track('lat,lon,ele
42,23,
42.1,23,
').elevations()
except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__, e)
"
